legal_entity: Bitpanda GmbH (affiliate terms, preamble); Bitpanda Asset Management GmbH is a party for German-resident referrals
application_conditions: Register with Impact Radius (terms B.1; campaign 'Bitpanda1649085811694'); 18+ (B.2); correct legal name and country of residence/incorporation (B.3); applicants in prohibited jurisdictions ineligible (B.3); Bitpanda may approve or reject 'for any lawful reason or none' (B.5). No eligibility criteria on the programme page itself.
paid_action: Terms C.1: CPA 'paid only when a qualified customer completes a qualified transaction'; Qualified Transaction = successful purchase of Services by a Qualified Customer (A.24); New Customer = no existing Bitpanda account (A.14); only the first account a customer opens is tagged (C.5). Programme page: 'Receive a commission for every referred user.'
validation_conditions: Terms C.8: direct referral without manipulating the tracking link; no fraudulent transactions; no self-referrals. Commission is VAT-inclusive (C.7).

commission.model_note: Programme page: CPA and Revenue Share options by traffic source, no rates. Affiliate terms C.1 (updated May 2024): CPA, CPC, CPI, CPL/CPV, fixed fee, revenue share and hybrids; rates "determined by Bitpanda" and shown in the Affiliate Account only; revenue share = % of Net Revenue (C.1(vi)); Bitpanda may change or end models at any time. Programme currency EUR (C.2–C.3).

payout.method: Paid to the affiliate's Impact Radius account, in EUR (terms C.2); Bitpanda not liable for currency risk (C.3)
payout.frequency: Billing period chosen by Bitpanda, e.g. monthly (C.4); weekly or monthly plans changeable on 24 h notice (I.1); payment "within a reasonable timeframe" (C.5)
payout.cancellation_note: Either party may terminate immediately with or without cause (J.1). J.2(b) says no further payment obligations after termination, while J.3 preserves accrued commission unless the affiliate breached — internal contradiction.

rules_note: Affiliate terms (updated May 2024, Austrian law K.1): no brand bidding or Bitpanda brands/misspellings in ads, ads must land on affiliate websites, Bitpanda landing page usable on affiliate websites only (E.13–E.14); email only if explicitly agreed, no unsolicited email (E.15); no SMS/fax/telemarketing/offline/malware/doorway pages/iframes (E.16); no cashback or other incentives without written approval (E.12); no competitor promotion during the term (E.22); fraud clauses E.23–E.33. exchange.bitpanda.com excluded (A.6). German-resident new customers may only be referred to Bitpanda Asset Management (E.4). Programme page FAQ answers still not rendered to the fetcher.
allowed_countries_note: Terms Annex I lists permitted territories per product (anything not listed is restricted, A.15/E.7); the table was only partly extracted (Åland Islands, Czech Republic, Faroe Islands visible) and has a "Bitpanda Card" column whose rows were not readable. Prohibited jurisdictions include Afghanistan, Cuba, Iran, Russia, Netherlands, Philippines, US Virgin Islands and others.

evidence.excerpt: Bitpanda GmbH (+ Bitpanda Asset Management GmbH for Germany); Impact Radius registration, 18+; CPA/CPC/CPI/CPL/fixed/revshare/hybrid, rates set in the Affiliate Account; EUR; payout to Impact account, e.g. monthly; no brand bidding, email only if agreed, no incentives without approval; Annex I territories per product incl. a Bitpanda Card column (rows not extracted); Austrian law.

notes: Terms must be read inside Impact after application; nothing more is public. 2026-11-10: programme page re-read (unchanged in substance, FAQ answers still unreadable) and the official affiliate T&C read for the first time: contractual framework now documented, but rates stay inside the Impact account. Whether the Bitpanda Card is a commissionable product depends on Annex I (not extracted) — browser read of the Annex needed. No application made.
